card.name: Comma after 'younger' before 'healthier'
card.fires_on: The punctuation or space right after 'younger' or 'sedentary' in a comparison of age or fitness groups, where a descriptor like 'healthier' or a number comes next. Strongest in the 'compared to younger, healthier patients' warning sentence.

modes.label: Younger, healthier patients
modes.description: Comma after 'younger' in the elderly-versus-younger patient comparison, just before 'healthier'.
modes.example: altered clearance compared to younger<<,>> healthier patients [see WARNINGS ] .

modes.label: Space after fitness descriptor
modes.description: Space after 'sedentary' before an age-group noun in a fitness comparison.
modes.example: a fit 40-year-old may out-compete a sedentary<< >>20-year-old.

card.writes: It seems to push toward a health-related word next, since 'health' tokens are suppressed, with the promoted tokens being unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the comma after 'younger' when the text is about to say 'healthier patients'.
